title: Original compressed eight-bit lighting dispatch
limits: DirectDraw Lock and Unlock are case-supplied indirect callbacks; all eight raster routines and their game helpers execute unchanged original code.
The canonical dispatcher is separate from the existing LightPIDBlitter app API and is not app-integrated.
notes: Every return path explicitly defines EAX as zero or one. Indexed game callers overwrite it, but the coordinator elects the stronger u32 parity contract to retain the existing value-returning blitter surface.
